summary: Practise cloud cost allocation, commitment reviews, and AI spend governance across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Explore the five-day course.
lede: FinOps links cloud usage and spending to business value, helping teams make costs visible and actionable. For cloud engineers, finance business partners, and technology leaders, it develops practical skills in allocating costs with tags, reviewing commitment utilization, and reporting GPU attribution and token-level AI inference spending.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for cloud cost visibility, optimization, financial accountability, or technology investment decisions across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
outcomes: AI Total Cost Of Ownership Analysis
modules: AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Analysis
FinOps Governance for AI Inference Costs
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Familiarity with cloud services, cloud invoices, or technology budgeting will help you apply the exercises. No programming is required. The course uses billing scenarios; access to a live AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud account is not required for the stated learning activities.
